name: my-extension
title: My Extension
description: A Raycast extension built from the template
author: harunonsystem

commands.name: index
commands.title: Browse Sample Items
commands.description: A sample command that displays a list

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "throw new Error('Use npm run publish to publish to the Raycast Store.')"
scripts.check-runtime-types: node -e "const assert = require('node:assert/strict'); const { peerDependencies } = require('./node_modules/@raycast/api/package.json'); for (const name of ['@types/node', '@types/react']) assert.equal(require(name + '/package.json').version, peerDependencies[name], name + ' must match the Raycast API peer dependency');"
